Irene / Laura — quick finance confirmation:

- Good to proceed with supplier creation. If Alpine invoices Redwood Inference Europe GmbH (DE123456789) and includes the German VAT ID on the invoice, we apply reverse-charge and no Swiss VAT is charged. No fiscal representative needed on their end for B2B services to our German entity.
- Procurement should capture their bank details exactly as on the sample invoice and set bank instruction notes on the supplier record (SEPA / IBAN / BIC). For cross-border CHF payments we occasionally require intermediary bank instructions; Alpine’s sample looks clean (IBAN provided).
- We also ask for a Certificate of Tax Residency (CTR) from the Swiss tax office if Alpine wants us to waive any potential withholding-related checks; ask them to supply it if available.
- PO flow: Procurement creates supplier record after we receive the signed onboarding form and the sample invoice; Finance will then approve and we’ll issue a PO number. Standard payment terms apply (Net 30 unless otherwise agreed).

If they instead invoice Redwood Inference, Inc. (U.S.), we’d need additional documentation (W-8 equivalent + potential withholding handling).
